# LEO vs synthetic US-style gold (patient level)

*Generated by `scripts/score_leo_vs_synth_gold.py`.  Unit = patient (notes aggregated); 30 patients (polish_val 10, synth_v3 20); seven fields.  `llm` = Med42-8B alone, `specialist` = EpExtra alone, `leo_auto` = claims routed ACCEPT, `leo_review` = ACCEPT + REVIEW.*

Current-ASM view: maintenance only (rescue drugs do not count); acute administrations never count.
